look_here_first: Start with the middle-sized fruit and leaflet count. Arizona walnut usually carries 9–15 broader leaflets and fruits about 2–3.5 cm across—larger than little walnut but far smaller than typical black walnut fruit.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: nut 1.8–2.7 cm, deeply longitudinally grooved but relatively smooth between grooves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: streams, rocky canyon sides, springs and mesic canyon woodland

lookalikes.differences: J. microcarpa has 17–25 much narrower leaflets and tiny fruit; J. nigra has 15–23 leaflets plus much larger 3.5–8 cm fruit and coarsely warty nut sculpture.
